# Productive-capital HANK evidence

Generated by tools/reference_validation/validate_hank_capital_equilibrium.py.
The JSON record binds numerical source files and every CSV/NPZ artifact by SHA-256.

Fixed physical parameters and fixed asset bounds are used on grids 10, 15, 20, and 30.
The rejected 10-point household solve and rank-16 determinacy failures are retained.
The 15/20 histories solve finite horizon-3, branch-depth-1 conditional equilibria;
they do not pass an adaptive horizon, branching, or quadrature acceptance gate.
The 30-point audit transports the full distribution under the local policy;
its market, full-marginal, compression and household Euler errors remain distinct.

Wall times were observed with verified single-thread BLAS where the record says so.
Concurrent host workload: Concurrent repository regression suite and other HANK validation jobs on this host.
These are not isolated performance measurements or timing requirements.

The installed-capital production block has a separate official-code comparison.
This economy is not a full replication of the published ABRS household/intermediary model.
